# TECG SOFT

> TECG SOFT (tecgs.com) is a Chennai, India-based software company building Agentic AI-powered platforms across three domains: smart identity and NFC card systems, healthcare technology, and custom application development. Founded on 20+ years of smart card engineering experience, the company serves governments, hospitals, and enterprises.

TECG SOFT's distinguishing characteristic is that autonomous AI agents are embedded in every platform it ships rather than offered as a separate product — agents that observe, plan, act, and learn inside production systems such as cancer-screening triage, clinical workflow routing, and lead scoring.

## Company

- [About TECG SOFT](https://tecgs.com/about.html): Company history, two decades of smart card security work, and the shift to Agentic AI.
- [Contact](https://tecgs.com/contact.html): Enquiry form and direct contact details. Based in Chennai, India. Email info@tecgs.com.

## Solution Domains

- [Solutions Overview](https://tecgs.com/solutions.html): Three domains, nine products, one Agentic AI engine.
- [SecureID](https://tecgs.com/secureid.html): NFC Java Card platforms unifying identity, insurance, payments, and health records on a single tap-enabled card, with bank-grade key management.
- [HealthEdge](https://tecgs.com/healthedge.html): End-to-end healthcare platforms spanning clinics, mobile health, cancer screening, and senior wellness. 2,000+ health posts digitized; 10M+ consultations.
- [BuildX](https://tecgs.com/buildx.html): Custom mobile and web applications with Agentic AI embedded — community portals, payment tracking, digital signage, and support systems.
- [Agentic AI Studio](https://tecgs.com/agentic-ai.html): The autonomous agent layer underlying every TECG SOFT platform.

## Products

- [eHealth+](https://tecgs.com/ehealth.html): Cloud-based paperless healthcare management — clinical workflows, virtual consultation, connected devices, digital lab and pharmacy, AI-powered triage.
- [WoW (Wellness on Wheels)](https://tecgs.com/wow.html): Mobile clinic platform for community cancer screening, deploying equipped units to rural and underserved areas for early detection of breast, cervical, lung, and oral cancers.
- [MiVita](https://tecgs.com/mivita.html): AI-powered senior wellness platform using voice, photo, and gesture input, with 24/7 monitoring that surfaces early warning signs ahead of critical events.
- [Tecgs WealthCard](https://tecgs.com/onewealth.html): Multi-service NFC Java Card carrying identity, insurance, wallet, health records, and professional profile. Works online and offline.
